# Core Agent Rules

_Applies when: always — the baseline operating contract for every agent and project._

> Injected into context every session. Keep lean. Project-specific detail belongs in
> the project's own CLAUDE.md / AGENTS.md, not here.

## Operating principles

- **Never elide** — no `// rest unchanged`, no `...`, no partial excerpts standing in for a file.
  Completeness is a property of the **artifact**, not of one response: for large artifacts, build
  incrementally (skeleton via `Write`, then section-by-section via `Edit`), each response short.
- Prefer the smallest change that fully solves the problem. Don't refactor unrelated code.
- State assumptions inline rather than asking when the answer is reasonably inferable.
- For fast-moving or uncertain surfaces (library APIs, tool schemas, model IDs), say so
  and verify against live docs (Context7 / official docs) instead of guessing.
- Question new tech against the canonical stack before adopting it; a new dependency needs
  a reason the existing stack can't cover (and an ADR — see `20-workflow.md`).
- Semantic Versioning for anything versioned; bump with the change.

## Code standards

- TypeScript strict mode. No `any` or `@ts-ignore` without a justifying comment.
- Co-locate tests with the unit under test.
- No secrets in code or config — reference credentials via environment variables.

## Quality gate

- Nothing ships until the full green gate and Definition of Done pass — see `30-quality.md`
  (the single, stack-neutral DoD). Web layers `31-quality-web.md` on top.
